Here is the total number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the forebrain (cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus) regions in human, pig and mouse.
```{r}
print("Human:")
sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
```
```{r}
print("Pig:")
sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
```
Mouse
```{r}
total_elevated_mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print (total_elevated_mouse)
```

Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.
